loadFailed: Could not load the save: {message}. Starting a new estate.

felling: A crew is felling {block}: {n} trees, {rp} in wages.

fileClosed: The police file is closed. Nothing on the estate is drawing attention now.

wildfire: Wildfire. The fire is no longer yours; it burns until the rain comes.

floodGone: The flood water has gone down.

ganoderma: Ganoderma: {n} palms on {block} turned visibly sick. Remove them before it spreads.
